calendarNotes: KSD's one-page calendar distinguishes the regular two-hour all-school Wednesday release from three-hour conference dismissals. whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first day for grades 1–12 moves one day earlier, from August 27 to August 26. Kindergarten moves from September 2 to August 31.
Preschool starts one day earlier, on September 8 instead of September 9.
Elementary conference weeks shift to October 12–16 and February 8–12, and the 2026–27 calendar explicitly adds ECSE no-school dates on the final two days of each conference week.
The secondary conference date moves from November 25 to November 24.
The last day for grades 1–12 moves from June 18 to June 17; ECSE moves from June 11 to June 10.

calendarFaqs.q: Does KSD release students early every Wednesday in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. All schools dismiss two hours early on Wednesdays beginning September 2. Closures and breaks override the schedule; families should confirm exact bell and bus times with their school.

calendarFaqs.q: How do KSD conference dismissals work in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools dismiss three hours early October 12–16 and February 8–12. Secondary schools dismiss three hours early for conferences on November 24.

calendarFaqs.q: Which conference dates are no-school days for ECSE?
calendarFaqs.a: ECSE programs do not meet October 15–16, 2026, or February 11–12, 2027. Those dates fall within the two elementary conference weeks.

calendarFaqs.q: Are April 16 and May 21 automatic school days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. KSD lists April 16 first and May 21 second as optional snow make-up days. Additional make-up time can occur after June 17 if district cancellations require it.
